protocol.kind: Global A-star with historical expected edge times; geometry targets only in screening
protocol.preference: cost = historical time * (1 - 0.6 link_support); positive and globally optimized
protocol.endpoint_attachment: nearest raw road node; same for three variants, recorded limitation
protocol.expansion_gate: Held-out geometry mean error at least 5% lower than same-endpoint shortest control, with paired day CI excluding zero; route variant chosen using Train only

conclusion: Geometry diagnostic is not duration MAE. Expand only if global routes beat control; no claim of full decision-focused neural training.
